prompt: What happens next in this redis-cli session against a cluster node?
explanation: The node refuses the GET because key user:42 hashes to slot 4813, which belongs to the node at 127.0.0.1:7001. The client should reissue the GET there; the -c option makes redis-cli follow such redirects automatically.

options.text: The client sends GET user:42 to 127.0.0.1:7001
The client retries GET user:42 on 127.0.0.1:7000 until the slot migrates back
Node 7000 copies the key to node 7001 before answering
The cluster rebalances slot 4813 back to node 7000
